Digital artist nohygiene creates surreal 3D characters that combine angelic imagery, early-internet aesthetics and intensely emotional scenes. Her recurring figures have oversized heads, metallic or pale bodies, long hair and wings. They appear alone, exhausted, in love or overwhelmed, while simple symbols such (Artvangarde)as hearts, fire and tears make their emotions immediately visible. The deliberately imperfect graphics recall early 3D animation, online avatars and old computer imagery, rather than the polished realism of contemporary CGI. Across her work, these strange digital beings (Artvangarde)become vessels for very human feelings love, loneliness, anxiety, desire and emotional vulnerability. #art #loveyou #artist #niche #heart

What is a digital product?👇 A digital product is anything you can sell online without shipping, storage, or inventory… it’s knowledge, value, and tools packaged into a file that someone can download instantly. It can be an ebook that teaches a skill, a Canva template that saves someone hours of work, a guide that shows people how to start from zero, a set of prompts, a course, a planner, or even a system that helps someone make money online. Once it’s created, it can be sold over and over again without you having to recreate it every time. That’s the power most people miss… you’re not trading time for money anymore, you’re building something that works while you’re asleep, while you’re at work, while you’re living your life. No shipping. No inventory. No boss. Just a laptop, WiFi, and something valuable enough that someone is willing to pay for it because it saves them time, teaches them something new, or helps them make money themselves. Digital products are how regular people are turning knowledge into income in 2026. Not by being experts… but by solving problems and packaging simple solutions in a clear way. If you can explain it, teach it, or simplify it… you can turn it into a digital product. 💡 The question isn’t “what is it?” anymore… it’s “what do I already know that someone else would pay for?”
